1: // Simple asteroid‑orbit canvas game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Set canvas size to match its displayed size
9:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
10:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
11: 
12:   const CENTER = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
13:   const PLANET_R = 30;
14:   const SHIP_R = 8;
15:   const AST_R = 12;
16:   const FUEL_R = 6;
17: 
18:   let ship = {
19:     angle: 0,               // radians
20:     radius: PLANET_R + 40,   // distance from centre
21:     rotSpeed: 0,            // -1/0/1 per frame
22:     thrust: false,
23:     fuel: 100,
24:     alive: true,
25:   };
26: 
27:   const asteroids = [];
28:   const fuels = [];
29:   let frame = 0;
30:   let gameOver = false;
31: 
32:   // ---------- Input ----------
33:   const keys = {};
34:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; });
35:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
36: 
37:   // ---------- Helpers ----------
38:   function polarToCart(angle, radius) {
39:     return {
40:       x: CENTER.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
41:       y: CENTER.y + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
42:     };
43:   }
44: 
45:   function distance(a, b) {
46:     const dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y;
47:     return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
48:   }
49: 
50:   // ---------- Game logic ----------
51:   function spawnAsteroid() {
52:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
53:     const radius = Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height) / 2 + 20;
54:     asteroids.push({ angle, radius, speed: 1 + Math.random() * 0.5 });
55:   }
56: 
57:   function spawnFuel() {
58:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
59:     const radius = Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height) / 2 + 20;
60:     fuels.push({ angle, radius, speed: 0.8 });
61:   }
62: 
63:   function update() {
64:     if (!ship.alive) return;
65:     // input handling
66:     ship.rotSpeed = 0;
67:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.rotSpeed = -0.03;
68:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.rotSpeed = 0.03;
69:     ship.thrust = keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0;
70: 
71:     // ship update
72:     ship.angle += ship.rotSpeed;
73:     if (ship.thrust) {
74:       ship.radius += 1; // thrust outward
75:       ship.fuel -= 0.2;
76:     } else {
77:       // natural drift inward (gravity)
78:       ship.radius -= 0.3;
79:     }
80:     // keep ship within bounds
81:     ship.radius = Math.max(PLANET_R + SHIP_R, ship.radius);
82: 
83:     // asteroids update
84:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.radius -= a.speed);
85:     // fuels update
86:     fuels.forEach(f => f.radius -= f.speed);
87: 
88:     // collision detection
89:     const shipPos = polarToCart(ship.angle, ship.radius);
90:     asteroids.forEach((a, i) => {
91:       const pos = polarToCart(a.angle, a.radius);
92:       if (distance(shipPos, pos) < SHIP_R + AST_R) {
93:         ship.alive = false;
94:         gameOver = true;
95:       }
96:       // remove asteroids that passed the planet
97:       if (a.radius < PLANET_R) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
98:     });
99:     fuels.forEach((f, i) => {
100:       const pos = polarToCart(f.angle, f.radius);
101:       if (distance(shipPos, pos) < SHIP_R + FUEL_R) {
102:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 30);
103:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
104:       }
105:       if (f.radius < PLANET_R) fuels.splice(i, 1);
106:     });
107: 
108:     // spawn timing
109:     if (frame % 120 === 0) spawnAsteroid(); // every 2 seconds @60fps
110:     if (frame % 500 === 0) spawnFuel();
111:     frame++;
112:   }
113: 
114:   // ---------- Rendering ----------
115:   function draw() {
116:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
117:     // planet
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#2b2b2b';
119:     ctx.beginPath();
120:     ctx.arc(CENTER.x, CENTER.y, PLANET_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
121:     ctx.fill();
122:     // ship
123:     const shipPos = polarToCart(ship.angle, ship.radius);
124:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.alive ? '#00ff00' : '#ff0000';
125:     ctx.beginPath();
126:     ctx.arc(shipPos.x, shipPos.y, SHIP_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
127:     ctx.fill();
128:     // asteroids
129:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
130:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
131:       const p = polarToCart(a.angle, a.radius);
132:       ctx.beginPath();
133:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, AST_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
134:       ctx.fill();
135:     });
136:     // fuels
137:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
138:     fuels.forEach(f => {
139:       const p = polarToCart(f.angle, f.radius);
140:       ctx.beginPath();
141:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, FUEL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
142:       ctx.fill();
143:     });
144:     // HUD
145:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
146:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
147:     ctx.fillText('Fuel: ' + Math.floor(ship.fuel), 10, 20);
148:     if (gameOver) {
149:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
150:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
151:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
152:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
153:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
154:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
155:     }
156:   }
157: 
158:   function loop() {
159:     if (!gameOver) update();
160:     draw();
161:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
162:   }
163: 
164:   // start the game
165:   loop();
166: })();

(End of file - total 166 lines)
